newsitem.title: JAPAN: JNR Corp to hold land auctions on Feb 28, March 6.
newsitem.headline: JNR Corp to hold land auctions on Feb 28, March 6.

text.p: The Japan National Railways Settlement Corp is planning to offer land owned by the now-defunct JNR through auctions on February 28 and March 6, officials said on Monday.
Five tracts of idle land covering 53,000 square metres located near Shinagawa station in Tokyo will be auctioned.

A total of 39 consortiums and companies made proposals for land development at the site, and auction participants will be chosen from among them sometime next week, the official for JNR Settlement Corp said.

JNR Settlement Corp will also hold an auction for about 4,800 square metres of land near Tokyo station on March 6, while a briefing for auction participants will be held on February 28, a Transport Ministry official said.
JNR Settlement Corp sold about 53,000 square metres of land located near Ginza, Tokyo's prime shopping district and once a freight station owned by JNR for 372.3 billion yen last Tuesday.
The sum exceeded most analysts' expectations of up to 300 billion yen, and led to the view that Japan's sluggish real estate market may be showing signs of revival.
